title: iNaturalist Research-Grade Conversion Lag
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inat:observation
| search research_grade_delay_hr=*
| stats avg(research_grade_delay_hr) as avg_research_grade_delay_hr perc90(research_grade_delay_hr) as p90_research_grade_delay_hr count as samples by taxon_group
| sort 0 - avg_research_grade_delay_hr
description: Measures research-grade conversion lag by taxon group.
value: Conversion lag shows which groups need better evidence or more patient reviewing.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for research-grade conversion lag to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 research-grade conversion lag.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how long research-grade conversion lag usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
